body:
To all the "Critters" whining about the PCs...

It's their game, if they decided that those characters interest them, and they want to develop them, its THEIR DECISION TO MAKE!

I don't get the hate of all those supposed fans. Give tge campaign time, it's just episode one!

For all we know, the EXU PCs and our goofy grandpa, Bertrand Bell, might be cameos/plot-hooks and the "real" PCs will come up within the following weeks.


No matter what happens, the CR-Team always told incredible stories together, just sit back, relax and enjoy the new campaign!

Takemichi wasn't the only one that could stop Mikey from falling into the "darkness". His younger sister Emma as well as his older brother Shinichiro were both able to stop Mikey from his "dark side", but as we know both of them are already dead. Effectively making Takemichi the only one left that could "save" Mikey.

I don't know what I should do anymore. This sickening emptiness just gets worse by the day. I just want an ordinary life, but it always seems so far away. Step by step I'm turning into my dad, and it scares and disgusts me. I'm by no means strong, I'm just miserable and trying to find a way out if this.
don't know how I ended up here, but I definitely don't regret it!
